summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $685K in annual recurring savings across six spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners helped Advantia Health optimize over $8.5 million in annual spend, delivering $684,936 in validated, recurring savings across six categories. Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for Billing Systems/RCM, a 14% cut in Medical Supplies costs through distributor consolidation, and the conversion of Sonography Services toward an in-house model. All categories have launched savings, with five fully implemented and Sonography Services midway through transition.
